text: 下面进入小作文 07 · 道歉与说明信：因突发科研任务致歉并协商改期，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【首段 · 保持书信温度】道歉和致谢不能全用物称！请保留 I am writing，同时用 failing to 替掉 not being able to：
I am writing to express my sincere apology for failing to attend tomorrow's seminar on modern literature as previously scheduled.
手术刀点拨：道歉与承诺补救属“红灯句”，必须亲自开口保住礼貌温度；failing to 使失约表述更地道。
【二段 · 交代客观理由】不要写 I am too busy tomorrow so I can't go。请让“紧急任务”做主语 + prevent sb. from：
Much to my regret, an urgent academic data task assigned by our department this morning prevents me from leaving the campus tomorrow.
手术刀点拨：过去分词短语 assigned by... 后置压缩修饰任务，让原因客观可信、无推卸感。
【补救 + 改期】记住道歉信不能光说对不起，要给方案：先提“提前发阅读笔记”，再委婉询问下周二改期：
To make up for the inconvenience caused, I would like to submit my reading notes in advance, and would it be possible to reschedule our discussion for next Tuesday?
手术刀点拨：To make up for the inconvenience caused + reschedule 是道歉/婉拒信双保险搭配。
